advisor_identified: Jeffrey R. Yost, historian of computing and technology, Charles Babbage Institute and University of Minnesota History of Science, Technology, and Medicine program.

doctorate.title: Components of the Past and Vehicles of Change: Parts Manufacturers and Supplier Relations in the U.S. Automobile Industry

evidence.says: His institutional CV lists a PhD in History of Technology and Science from Case Western Reserve University in 1998, and identifies him as CBI director and a Minnesota HSTM faculty member since 2010.

The published chapter references Jeffrey Robert Yost, Components of the Past and Vehicles of Change: Parts Manufacturers and Supplier Relations in the U.S. Automobile Industry, as a 1998 Case Western Reserve University PhD dissertation.
The indexed Smithsonian Libraries catalogue entry attributes the same dissertation title to Jeffrey Robert Yost and dates the manuscript to 1998 (viii, 420 leaves).

Minnesota lists Nicholas Lewis as a 2019 History of Science and Technology PhD with the dissertation Safety in Numbers: Creating and Contesting the Los Alamos Approach to Supercomputing, 1942-1980, matching the student dissertation in this entry.

notes: The institution, year, author name and title match the linked AHA record; U.S. is expanded to United States in AHA. The student dissertation is independently located at Minnesota, although the career tracker does not name its supervisor. Smithsonian catalogue details were available in the search index; direct access returned 403.
